Proven experience managing financial transactions within Contracts and Grants administration.
Hands-on experience using Kuali Financial System (KFS) and UCPath for institutional financial management.
Execute core post-award transactions, including submitting General Error Corrections (GECs) in KFS alongside Funding Entries (FEs) and Salary Cost Transfers (SCTs) in UCPath.
Generate and analyze Distribution of Payroll Expense (DOPE) reports for Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPRs) and Payroll Certification System (PCS) compliance.
Perform routine account reconciliations, pull monthly ledgers, and research and clear encumbrances to ensure grant compliance.
Maintain organized digital file archives, download and sort large datasets in Excel, and provide general administrative support to the post-award team.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (downloading, sorting, formatting, and analyzing large financial datasets).
Strong transactional admin and data entry skills with high attention to detail and file organization.
Familiarity with UC system policies, payroll distribution reporting, and post-award compliance standards.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
